canonical_project: Ethio telecom Gola Sefer modular data center (Huawei)
notes: State telco Tier III-ready modular data centre launched May 2021 in Gola Sefer, Addis Ababa; Huawei-built, 5 PODs x 16 cabinets supporting up to 800 servers; operator signed DC-leasing agreements with five financial/ISP institutions (2022). Operator page (A) plus DCD/Addis Fortune/Monitor detail (B).
